scope: The August 2024 exterior of Igreja Matriz do Divino Pai Eterno in Trindade, Goiás, with blue trim, two pointed-roof towers, clock gable, and long nave. This is the 1912 Santuário Velho overlooking the original square.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Goiás Tourism identifies the original 1912 church and describes its restoration in 2014.
The federal heritage institute identifies the 1912 parish church as the Santuário Velho and distinguishes the later basilica on the hill.
